Explaining the decision in the blog post, the team said that while they saw a committed community "fully embrace" the game in many ways, "it just wasn't happening enough.

Riot said that after evaluating the game's performance — revenue, retention, new players, and engagement — but that even with major new updates, the company "saw no meaningful, sustained change in 2XKO’s trajectory; only a fraction of what it would take to trend toward sustainability.
As announced at Evo 2026, Lux, the Lady of Luminosity, will arrive in September alongside 2XKO patch 1.3.1.

The team went on to give a preview of what’s coming next for the game: In the coming months, Riot will disable KO Points purchases, refund all purchases made prior to August 20, add a purchasable bundle of nearly all 2XKO cosmetic content for $39.99, and make most items available for Credits.
